record.question: In the following question, a statement is followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. Assume everything in the statement to be true. Decide which of the two suggested courses of action logically follows for pursuing. Statement: Majority of the students have failed in one paper in the first semester examination. Courses of Action: I. All those students who failed should be asked to drop out of the course. II. The faculty teaching the paper should be asked to resign.
options: If both I and II follows
If neither I nor II follows
